derivation: middle voice from an apparently primary (a sum or price);
def: to purchase (synonymous with the earlier G4092 (πίμπρημι))

occurrences.text: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
